safe_with_current_wording.recommended_copy: Asina Global works with an established manufacturing partner in Vietnam to support custom cabinetry, bathroom cabinetry, hotel furniture, and related millwork programs.
The partner facility supports cutting, edge banding, CNC machining, painting, assembly, door production, packing, warehousing, technical development, and export logistics.

Capabilities include kitchens, vanities, wardrobes and closets, utility-room cabinetry, built-ins, cabinet fronts, hardware, storage accessories, mouldings, range hood covers, glass fronts, and countertop coordination.
Available construction approaches include particleboard, MDF, and plywood cores, Confirmat-and-dowel or concealed plastic-dowel-and-glue assembly, and coordinated PVC edgebanding.

home: What product selections can I explore with Asina Global?

The current site brings together Kitchen, Vanity, and Wardrobe / Closet programs; door profiles; materials and finishes; cabinet configurations; accessories and range hoods; countertops and full-height backsplashes; and complete-room references.
How is product selection organized?
Follow the current decision path: room direction, cabinet specifications, door profile, materials and finishes, cabinet configuration, accessories, countertops, complete room, then consultation.
How many door profiles are shown?
The Door Profiles page indexes 17 profiles. Other profile requests can be reviewed for technical feasibility.
How many finish references are shown?
Materials & Finishes indexes 172 records across nine families. Asina Global’s broader finish range includes 600+ colours.
What is the Asina Global TFL finish line?
TFL means thermally fused laminate. It is Asina Global’s most cost-efficient finish line, with 58 references: 42 woodgrain, 14 solid, and 2 fabric looks.
Can Asina Global review a custom color or door profile?
If a requested color or profile is not among the current references, Asina Global can review a custom request subject to technical feasibility, sample approval, quantity, and quote.
Does Asina Global publish cabinet prices?
No. Pricing is prepared by project because drawings, quantities, construction, profile, finish, accessories, packing, destination, and shipping responsibility affect the quote.
Who manufactures Asina Global cabinetry?
Asina Global works with an established manufacturing partner in Vietnam. Asina remains the supplier of record and coordinates project communication, approvals, QA, packing, and shipping planning.
How is quality confirmed before production?
Drawings and selections are reviewed first. A sample or mockup can then confirm dimensions, construction, color, finish, materials, and details before repeat production.
What should I send for a cabinet consultation?
Send the room type, plans or cabinet runs, preferred style, door profile, finish direction, cabinet list or unit count, accessories, destination, and timeline.
cabinets: Which kitchen directions can I explore?

The current Collections section presents Contemporary, Traditional, and Transitional kitchen directions. Continue to Door Profiles, Materials & Finishes, and Quick Book references as you refine the selection.
How many door profiles can I choose from?
The Door Profiles page indexes 17 profiles. Asina Global can review requests outside these references for technical feasibility.
What finish families are available?
The 172 finish records include natural, stained, painted, matte lacquer laminate, acrylic, high-gloss PET, high-pressure laminate, engineered veneer, and TFL options.
What makes TFL the cost-efficient finish line?
Thermally fused laminate offers a broad decorative surface range. Materials & Finishes shows 58 TFL references: 42 woodgrain, 14 solid, and 2 fabric looks.
How many cabinet configurations are in the Quick Book?

The Asina Global Quick Book organizes 362 coded configurations across base cabinets, islands, wall cabinets, drawer boxes, panels and fillers, posts, brackets, mouldings, vanities, wardrobes, and closets.
Which accessories are shown?

The Accessories page includes corner storage, waste-bin systems, spice and basket pullouts, and a pantry swivel basket, including Lazy Susan, swing-corner, Wari-corner, and single- or double-bin options.
Does the selection flow include more than kitchens?
Yes. The site also presents Vanity and Wardrobe / Closet programs, range hoods, countertops, full-height backsplashes, mouldings, panels, fillers, and related cabinet components.
Can a color or profile be customized?

If a requested color or door profile is not among the current references, Asina Global can review a custom request. Feasibility, sample approval, quantity, and quote are confirmed during project review.
How are finishes confirmed?
Asina reviews the selected finish against an approved sample or mockup, then uses that reference during production QA.
What should buyers send for cabinet pricing?
Send room plans or cabinet runs, style direction, door profile, finish, coded cabinet list when available, accessories, quantity, destination, and timeline.
quickBook: What is the Asina Global Quick Book?
It is the coded product library used to identify cabinet and component configurations by name, code, and reference image.
How many products are in the Quick Book?
The current library contains 362 coded records across 10 product categories.
Base cabinets, islands, wall cabinets, drawer boxes, panels and fillers, posts and bar brackets, mouldings, vanity cabinets, wardrobe cabinets, and closet cabinets.
Can the Quick Book be used as a price list?
No. It identifies products for planning and quoting. Pricing still depends on construction, finish, quantity, custom work, packing, destination, and project terms.
tfl: TFL means thermally fused laminate, a decorative surface fused to a panel substrate for cabinet and interior applications.
How many TFL finishes are shown?
Materials & Finishes indexes 58 TFL references: 42 woodgrain, 14 solid, and 2 fabric looks.
Is TFL the most cost-efficient Asina Global finish line?
TFL is presented as Asina Global’s most cost-efficient finish line. Project pricing depends on the approved cabinet specification and scope.
Can TFL be used for kitchens, vanities, wardrobes, and closets?
TFL can be reviewed across compatible cabinet and interior applications. Final suitability depends on the selected product, construction, edge treatment, and project requirements.
design: Is this a standalone interior design service?
No. It is design-to-production support that turns room intent, cabinet layouts, profiles, finishes, custom sizing, and related selections into reviewable production details.
Begin with the room and one of the three design directions: Contemporary, Traditional, or Transitional. Then select the door profile, finish, cabinet configuration, accessories, and surfaces.
How does the Quick Book help?
The Quick Book provides names, codes, and reference images for 362 cabinet and component configurations so the project team can identify required products more precisely.
Can custom sizing, colors, or profiles be reviewed?
Yes. Custom requests are reviewed against drawings, technical feasibility, materials, quantity, sample requirements, and production constraints before pricing is finalized.
Send floor plans or cabinet runs, elevations when available, room type, style direction, door profile, finish, cabinet codes, accessories, unit count, and timeline.
How does the design become a production reference?
Approved drawings and selections move into a sample or mockup review. Once approved, that reference guides repeat production, QA, and packing checks.
qualityAndPartner: Who is Asina Global's manufacturing partner?
Asina Global works with an established manufacturing partner in Vietnam. Asina is the supplier of record and remains responsible for project review, approvals, communication, and coordinated handoff.
What production capabilities does the partner support?
The partner supports panel cutting, edge banding, CNC work, painting and finishing, door production, assembly, packing, warehousing, technical development, and export logistics.
How does Asina reduce measurement risk?
Asina reviews drawings and cabinet selections before production details are finalized. A mockup or sample can then establish the approved reference for repeat production.
How are colors and finishes checked?
The selected color and finish are confirmed against the approved sample or mockup and reviewed for consistency during production QA.
Packing review can cover item counts, room or cabinet labels, organization, added protection, moisture planning, and shipment readiness.
Shipping responsibility is set during the project quote. Asina can coordinate freight planning based on destination, delivery needs, and the responsibility level agreed in writing.
How long do production and shipping take?

Timing is project-specific and depends on approved drawings, custom work, quantity, finish complexity, production capacity, freight route, and destination. The project quote confirms the working schedule.
Does Asina Global own the factory?
No. The facility is operated by Asina Global's manufacturing partner. Asina coordinates the customer-facing project, selection, approval, QA, packing, and logistics path.
about: Asina Global LLC is a Florida-based project supplier for cabinets, countertops, and custom furniture packages. It coordinates product selection, drawings, approvals, QA, packing, and shipping planning.
Who is Asina Global built for?
Asina supports builders, developers, dealers, procurement teams, general contractors, designers, restaurant groups, franchise operators, and repeat-project buyers.
What is Asina Global's relationship with the factory?
Asina Global works with an established manufacturing partner in Vietnam. The partner operates the production facility; Asina remains the supplier of record for the customer project.
What can the manufacturing partner produce?
Capabilities include kitchen cabinets, vanities, wardrobes and closets, utility cabinetry, built-ins, doors, mouldings, hood covers, panels, fillers, and related hardware or accessories.
Can one project include multiple categories?
Yes. Asina can coordinate cabinets, countertops, furniture packages, and related room applications when one organized review makes the scope clearer.
Where is Asina Global LLC based?
Asina Global LLC is based in Longwood, Seminole County, Florida, within the Greater Orlando market, and can coordinate qualified project work nationwide.
